title: Health probes and failover do not weaken transport security
summary: Health probes use the same authenticated session establishment and encrypted secure-frame machinery as delivery. Client failover may try ordered endpoints after eligible transport failures, but each endpoint must independently satisfy its cryptographic configuration and the listener still applies exact source-IP admission.
invariants: PROBE and HEALTH are encrypted/authenticated after the challenge just like DELIVER/RESULT.
Failover is an endpoint-selection behavior, not a permission to downgrade crypto, bypass IP admission, or reuse another endpoint's identity.
Health success/failure counters are observability evidence, not admission authority.

provenance.claim: Client delivery/probe iterate eligible endpoint candidates and use failover rules.
Health response is opened as S2C secure data and updates endpoint health counters.
Encrypted health/failover and transport NoSQL qualification passed.
